episodes.title: Lunapark
episodes.summary: A body found in an amusement park in Istanbul leads Commissioner Sare to cross paths with renowned fashion photographer Atlas. Unable to understand why photographs of the victim were left at the victim's bedside, Atlas tries to prove his innocence, while Sare's suspicions about Atlas grow increasingly stronger as she investigates the case.

episodes.title: Taş, Kağıt....
episodes.summary: As the investigation deepens, Sare begins to explore the connection between the murder victims and Atlas, and forgotten memories resurface. Meanwhile, Atlas, upon discovering a new photograph in the darkroom, comes face-to-face with another victim.

episodes.title: Sorular....
episodes.summary: As Sare and Atlas follow a series of clues that reshape their connection to the past, an unexpected figure emerges. Simultaneously, events leading up to a conference plunge Atlas and Sare into a new predicament.

episodes.title: Iz....
episodes.summary: The repercussions of a new murder create irreversible ruptures in everyone's lives. Atlas and Sare now have to contend not only with external threats but also with the darkness within themselves, and it remains unclear who is guilty and who is the victim.

episodes.title: Duvardaki Fotoğraf....
episodes.summary: The tense encounter in the cemetery pushes Sare and Atlas's relationship to a breaking point. They find themselves in the midst of the unknown.

episodes.title: İncir Uyutması...
episodes.summary: The rising tension in the interrogation rooms shifts the balance within the police force. Atlas and Sare get one step closer to solving everything.

episodes.title: Enis....
episodes.summary: As old wounds are reopened, family ties, losses, and confrontations become intertwined with a great mystery. The secrets that psychologist Enis has carried from the past to the present determine the fate of Atlas and Sare.

episodes.title: Aşk Ve Başlangıç....
episodes.summary: As the truth begins to surface, Atlas and Sare confront their past and reach an unexpected ending.
